task_name: Treat valid non-object JSON state as disconnected state
grader_mode: Host reads final candidate diff and independently rebuilds/installs the package; rubric is kept outside the candidate.

criteria.check: For valid JSON roots null, array, string, number, and both boolean values, StateStore._load() returns an empty BridgeState without raising.
Missing state files and malformed JSON continue to load as an empty BridgeState.
Valid object state continues to deserialize the supported state fields.
connect() and disconnect() persist state and round-trip correctly.
The candidate adds tests covering the non-object roots and retains coverage for all preserved behaviors.
A wheel built from the final candidate installs offline and the complete project test suite passes.
Product changes are limited to src/orca_discord_bridge/state.py and tests/test_harness_compatibility.py.
No live Discord or Orca calls, network access, publication, push, or merge.
